codespace_probability_coefficients.description: Polynomial coefficients of P_cs(p) = Tr(Pi rho(p) Pi), from constant term (p^0) to highest power. Each coefficient is an exact rational number as a string (e.g. '1', '-12/5').

population_00_coefficients.description: Polynomial coefficients of q_{00}(p) = <00_L| Pi rho(p) Pi |00_L>, the projected population of the target logical state |00>_L. Exact rationals as strings.

population_01_coefficients.description: Polynomial coefficients of q_{01}(p) = <01_L| Pi rho(p) Pi |01_L>. Exact rationals as strings.

population_10_coefficients.description: Polynomial coefficients of q_{10}(p) = <10_L| Pi rho(p) Pi |10_L>. Exact rationals as strings.

population_11_coefficients.description: Polynomial coefficients of q_{11}(p) = <11_L| Pi rho(p) Pi |11_L>. Exact rationals as strings.

infidelity_leading_power.description: The smallest integer k >= 1 such that the coefficient of p^k in the Taylor expansion of 1 - F_L(p) is nonzero, where F_L(p) = q_{00}(p) / P_cs(p).

infidelity_leading_coefficient.description: The exact rational coefficient 'a' such that 1 - F_L(p) = a * p^k + O(p^{k+1}), as a string (e.g. '4/15').

constraints: All polynomial coefficients must be exact rational numbers as strings (e.g. '1/3', not '0.333')
P_cs(p) must equal the sum q_{00}(p) + q_{01}(p) + q_{10}(p) + q_{11}(p)
All polynomials have degree <= 3 (three noise channels, each linear in p, up to cubic terms)
